rh.veraltet: The demand or offer has changed. Review today’s options again.
rh.messungOffen: Today’s metric already meets the target. The next ministry report will assess it; no further spending is required for that target.
rh.keinPufferNoetig: Expected votes already include the intended margin.
rh.laeuft: This bill has already been introduced. You can still strengthen its majority.
rh.verhandelt: The existing bill has received new support.
rh.ausgefuehrt: Steps executed and recorded. The result demand stays open until recovery is measured.
rh.haushalt: Deficit {def} percentage points of GDP · legitimacy {leg} · approval {zust}.
rh.unveraendert: No immediate change in faction willingness or personal loyalty.
rh.fach: Effect channel towards {name}. Implementation approximately {monate} months; additional model delay up to {lag} months.
rh.bip: Annual direct fiscal effect: {n}% of GDP. Positive means extra cost; negative means relief.
rh.mehrheit: Vote {datum}: {ja} expected yes votes out of 301 required; {fehlt} still missing.
rh.stimmenDelta: Compared with the measure alone: {n} votes.
rh.duldung: {partei}: outside support ends on {datum} ({sitze} seats). The vote forecast accounts for this.
rh.zuSpaet: The vote falls on or after the result deadline of {frist}. This route cannot assure timely fulfilment.
rh.umsetzungOffen: Result deadline: {frist}. Even a timely vote needs time to take effect; a two-point improvement is not guaranteed.
rh.ohneVotum: This amendment uses the existing immediate budget power: no additional vote, but a legitimacy cost. It is blocked during the budget window or a pending budget bill.
rh.prognoseGesperrt: No reliable vote forecast is available for this currently blocked route.
rh.neueZusagen: New binding promises from this package
rh.keineZusage: This step creates no additional faction promise when executed. The result demand remains.
rh.annahme: Additional effects if the bill passes
rh.bedingt: Conditional calculation using today’s political situation. Future crises, personnel changes and actual vote variation are not predicted.
rh.bruch: {phase}: {partei}, {name} at {loy} loyalty. If unchanged, {sitze} government seats are at risk on {datum}.
rh.oeffnen: How can I fulfil this demand?
rh.grenze: Measures affect the requested metric through existing model relationships. Decision, effect and fulfilment are separate steps. These offers do not extend the deadline.
rh.keine: No new directly linked step is currently available. Review ongoing implementation, the budget and related causes; no effect is invented here.
rh.paketHinweis: Up to four current routes. The price includes the selected measure and negotiations. Everything is rechecked before execution; a blocked step prevents all bookings. An agreement may bind you to further political goals.
rh.keinKompromiss: No currently available agreement improves this forecast or coalition support. The majority gap remains open.
rh.keineBuchung: This route is currently blocked. Nothing is booked.
rh.verlauf: Steps taken in response to these demands
rh.belegGrenze: Recorded effects at the time of action. Later measurements show whether the ministry recovers; a connection alone does not establish causation.
